title: discount panics on an unknown coupon code
body:
`discount` divides by the coupon rate without checking it is non-zero.

```bash
cargo run
```

```
thread 'main' (96845654) panicked at src/main.rs:5:14:
attempt to divide by zero
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```
